title: Strengthening Negotiable Instruments: SC holds rebuttal of Section 139 must await trial
description: In a significant judgment concerning the scope and application of Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881, (“Act”) the Supreme Court reiterated that at the stage of issuance of process, the Court is only required to examine whether the basic ingredients of Section 138 of the Act are prima facie satisfied.
